services.name: Cbd Massage
services.desc: Eastern massage includes Shiatsu, a traditional Japanese style massage literally meaning “finger pressure”. It is an ancient form of massage performed to release energy blockages. Thumbs, fingers, forearms, elbows, knees, and feet are used to apply pressure to specific areas of the body, while stretching encourages the invigorating movement of internal energy. Traditionally, this is dry massage; oil is not used during this service. For a truly authentic experience, pair your Shiatsu with a visit to our communal, Japanese-inspired bathhouse.
